# UX State-Machine Checklist: Questionnaire Feedback

**Purpose**: Validate that the feature requirements fully specify the questionnaire state machines for confirmatory timing, prompt suppression, surface collision avoidance, session-end cadence, and weekly ISO-week re-prompt behavior.
**Created**: 2026-06-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

**Status (2026-06-30, feature complete)**: All items satisfied. The sustained-tense /
dwell-floor / one-per-session / single-resolution / next-session false-alarm-suppression /
chat-signal-exclusion state machine is proved by `confirmatory-trigger.test.ts` (T028) as pure
reducers + a hooked wiring. Surface anti-collision (confirmatory ↔ session-end never co-occur;
prompt resolves first; weekly separate from active monitoring) is the centralized pure
`decideQuestionnaireSurface` in `questionnaire-coordinator.test.tsx` (T052). The ISO-week cadence
(first visit / one re-prompt after skip / second-skip suppression / completed suppression /
abandoned-Q2) is proved by `weekly-cadence.test.ts` (T046). The every-session sampling seam is
`session-feedback-sampling.test.ts` (T038).
